user.title: Link your account
user.description: Sign in to wanneeraanzetten.nl. Home Assistant stores a read-only token, not your password. Prices exclude taxes and supplier fees.

two_factor.title: Two-step verification
two_factor.description: Enter your authenticator code or a recovery code. If your sign-in has expired, restart account linking.

error.invalid_auth: Sign-in failed or expired. Check your credentials or restart account linking.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to wanneeraanzetten.nl. Try again later.

abort.wrong_account: Sign in with the account originally linked to this integration.
abort.reauth_successful: Your account has been linked again.

init.title: Energy contract setup
init.description: Set the electricity market and choose how price intervals match your contract. Supplier costs and taxes remain managed in your Wanneer Aanzetten account.

menu_option_descriptions.market: Choose the bidding zone for your home.

market.title: Electricity market
market.description: Choose the bidding zone used for day-ahead electricity prices.

contract.title: Contract price interval
contract.description: Follow the price interval saved in your account, or choose an interval for this Home Assistant installation. Update supplier fees and taxes in your account settings; the link is on the price sensor and dashboard card.
